audio_narrative_en.title: Market Closes
audio_narrative_en.text: In Friday’s session the S&P 500 closed at 7,580 points, down 1.82%. The VIX rose to 19.42, up 12.91%. The Dollar Index fell to 101.88, down 0.16%. Gold fell to $3,089.90 an ounce, down 3.29%. Brent rose to $117.64, up 2.40%. The 10‑year Treasury yield fell to 4.92%, down 1.20%. The 20‑year TLT gained to 81.84, up 0.43%. audio_narrative_en.title: News and Outlook
audio_narrative_en.text: The ECB Governing Council’s decisions, including discussions on future rate hikes, could weigh on Monday’s opening, with investors potentially demanding a higher risk premium. Geopolitical tensions related to the Ukraine conflict and sanctions could keep the VIX elevated, driving investors toward defensive assets at Monday’s open.
